name: zscn-theme-flip-dark-surface
description: ThemeFlip's Dark pane must resolve the dark surface tokens inside a light ambient theme (kata zscn)

mutation.declaration: styles/tokens.css: :root, [data-theme="dark"] { ... } (reverted the selector to :root only, dropping nested-dark-pane scoping from 8b06eb411)
mutation.note: Re-verified against the approved 2026-09-09 editorial-instrument palette (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-09-tufte-webui-design.md). In an isolated frontend copy, baseline passed; removing only the nested dark selector failed all three dark probes: --surface-1 resolved to #FCFBF8 instead of #232320, pane background to rgb(250, 249, 246) instead of rgb(25, 25, 24), and surface probe to rgb(252, 251, 248) instead of rgb(35, 35, 32). Restoring the selector passed. Light custom-property and painted-surface probes remain unchanged in scope and strength.
